description: Resolve an actor name (organization or person) to the EXACT spelling used in the AMB metadata, so it can be passed to the publisherName/creatorName filters of search_resources. Those filters are exact full-string matches (case-insensitive), so a guessed spelling like "Lehreladen" silently misses the stored "LEHRE LADEN". This tool free-text searches the name and returns the similar publisher/creator names found in the corpus, with the field they appear in and a resource count. Distinct from resolve_author, which resolves Nostr signing accounts (kind-0 profiles) to pubkeys — metadata publishers usually have no Nostr account at all.

name.description: Actor name as the user said it (e.g. "Lehreladen").

relays.description: Restrict the lookup to specific relays. Only relays returned by list_relays (default or extra) are accepted, by full URL or short name (e.g. "oersi", "sodix"). Default: the default relay set.

name: resolve_publisher
title: Resolve Publisher/Creator Name to Canonical Metadata Spelling
